root_injections: Shifts the ordinal severity scale by one category.

human_repair_overrides.content: Treat AESEV values 1 through 4 as if they were recorded on a zero-based 0 through 3 scale by subtracting one before aggregation. Analyze this recoded severity as a continuous Gaussian outcome rather than an ordered response, but when the treatment effect is requested, reuse the archived ordinal-logit slope table instead of refitting.
